# Harsh Kharavle — portfolio summary

This portfolio features three projects and avoids unverified production claims.

- Hybrid Log Classifier: confidence-aware rules → local ML → optional LLM classification, explicit abstention, incident grouping, and reproducible load testing. The load-report/log triage extension is proposed in PR #5 and is not merged into the default branch.
- KAY-KAY: LLM gateway prototype with hashed API keys, spend reservation, and telemetry. Provider integrations are deterministic stubs; accounting and rate limits are process-local.
- Recoup: deterministic payment reconciliation using integer paise, bounded timestamp matching, one-to-one matching, and a separate recovery-policy gate. No money-execution API or LLM dependency.

Baseline test counts are recorded in data/evidence.json. They describe the listed default-branch snapshots, not production reliability or live usage.
